blocks.text: 2 Samuel 22 contains 51 verses. It opens with: And David spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: It concludes with: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Second Samuel moves from David's accession and kingdom consolidation through ark and dynasty promise to royal abuse, household violence, rebellion, grief, and a four-part closing appendix.
